# The batched LZ4 C entry points of libnvcomp.so.5.3.0.16, plus the two
# library-wide calls, read from the pinned redist archive's .dynsym: every
# STB_GLOBAL/STB_WEAK, STT_FUNC symbol with a defined section index.
#
# archive: nvcomp-linux-x86_64-5.3.0.16_cuda12-archive.tar.xz
# sha256:  1def6bb0fa51d8ea3fe0c43ae1c58df2f63808ced7444267e14245583ec23f6f
# member:  lib/libnvcomp.so.5.3.0.16
# soname:  libnvcomp.so.5
# read on: 2026-09-04
#
# The shared object itself is deliberately not vendored; this list is the one
# fact taken from it.
#
# The library defines 133 undecorated C symbols in all: the same ten-call
# batched shape for ANS, Bitcomp, Cascaded, Deflate, Gdeflate, Gzip, Snappy and
# Zstd, three CRC32 calls, 38 lower-level bitcomp* calls, and the two below.
# It also exports C++ symbols for the nvcomp::*Manager classes. None of those
# is bound here: this package is the batched LZ4 API and nothing else, so a
# symbol appearing in this file that is not one of the twelve is a change in
# what the package claims to be.
#
# There is no nvcompBatchedLZ4CompressGetTempSize in 5.3.0. Earlier nvCOMP
# releases had a single call by that name; this one splits it into the Async
# and Sync variants below, and the Sync variant takes a stream.
nvcompBatchedLZ4CompressAsync
nvcompBatchedLZ4CompressGetMaxOutputChunkSize
nvcompBatchedLZ4CompressGetRequiredAlignments
nvcompBatchedLZ4CompressGetTempSizeAsync
nvcompBatchedLZ4CompressGetTempSizeSync
nvcompBatchedLZ4DecompressAsync
nvcompBatchedLZ4DecompressGetRequiredAlignments
nvcompBatchedLZ4DecompressGetTempSizeAsync
nvcompBatchedLZ4DecompressGetTempSizeSync
nvcompBatchedLZ4GetDecompressSizeAsync
nvcompGetProperties
nvcompGetStatusString
